items.title: Bulgaria: Unknown drone explodes near Romanian border
items.description: A drone that entered Bulgaria's airspace exploded near the Romanian border and the Trans-Balkan gas pipeline, the Bulgarian prime minister said. Bulgaria summoned the Ukrainian ambassador for consultations.

items.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy makes first visit to Russia-friendly Serbia
items.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy is making his first visit to Serbia. His host, President Aleksandar Vucic, hopes to score points with the EU, while Zelenskyy seeks more arms from a country that remains friendly to Russia.

sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Iceland’s EU vote: A nation divided over Europe
items.description: Security concerns, control over fishing rights and rising living costs are shaping Iceland's debate over whether to restart talks on joining the European Union.

items.title: EU holds talks with big tech over Ceuta misinformation
items.description: EU digital chief Henna Virkkunen has called for closer monitoring of social media platforms moving forward, amid the spread of misinformation during the recent migrant influx at Spain's Ceuta.

items.title: Trump's ex-lawyer Todd Blanche narrowly confirmed as US attorney general
items.description: The vote cements Trump's former criminal defence lawyer as the nation's top law enforcement official despite a rare pushback from some Republicans.

items.title: US Senate confirms Trump loyalist Todd Blanche as new AG
items.description: Republicans dropped their opposition and confirmed President Donald Trump's former defense lawyer to a Cabinet position. Now, Todd Blanche will act as the nation's top law enforcement officer.

items.title: Book hidden in fireplace returned to Australian library 150 years overdue
items.description: It is thought an apprentice stonemason who worked on the Houses of Parliament in London borrowed it.
